dimensions.relevance: Does the question address a concrete requirement in this job?
dimensions.personalization: Is it usefully connected to literal CV evidence, without rewarding invented detail?
dimensions.correctness: Are question premises AND generated criteria technically sound? Generated criteria are unreviewed proposals, not authoritative answers.
dimensions.difficulty: Is the expected scope and reasoning proportionate to this role and experience level, regardless of the generated difficulty label?
dimensions.diversity: Across seven questions, are competencies distinct and sufficiently varied? Rate once per set.
dimensions.unsupported_assumption: 0=no unsupported candidate-history/ability assumption; 1=one or more. Cite the offending text.
dimensions.grounding: For cited RAG questions only: does the cited source semantically support the question, beyond shared words? 1=unsupported through 5=directly supported.

not_assessable: Use no number and explain why; do not turn uncertainty into a low score. Technical correctness may be not assessable for nontechnical questions.
blinding: Complete core.csv before opening grounding.csv. Do not discuss outputs with the other evaluator before submission.
no_rag: Citation absence is not a defect for no-RAG. Grounding is not applicable.
approval: Explicit reviewer/date/status required. Agent comments do not constitute human ratings.
